Wenn du auf das Notensymbol tippst, über: When you tap the musical-note icon, the app passes the Spanish learning phrase to your operating system’s speech service. Whether voices or speech services use the internet depends on your device, settings and provider. PhraseUNO does not record audio or request microphone access.
